# Kerala Sellers — llms.txt

> Kerala Sellers is a zero-commission e-commerce platform that helps Instagram and WhatsApp sellers in Kerala launch their own online stores in under 10 minutes. Sellers keep 100% of every sale.

## What we do

Kerala Sellers gives small businesses in Kerala — including home bakers, resellers, artisans, fashion boutiques, and grocery stores — their own store link to share on social media and WhatsApp. Buyers can browse products, add to cart, and place orders directly. Sellers manage orders through a simple dashboard.

## Key features

- Own store link (e.g., keralasellers.in/shop/your-shop-name)
- Custom subdomain (e.g., yourshop.keralasellers.in) — Premium plan
- Product catalog with images, prices, categories, and stock control
- WhatsApp order notifications for sellers
- UPI and Razorpay payment support
- 0% commission on every sale — sellers pay a flat monthly subscription
- Works for Instagram sellers, WhatsApp resellers, home bakers, boutiques

## Pricing

Kerala Sellers charges a flat monthly or annual subscription fee. There is zero commission on sales. Pricing plans include Free, Basic, and Premium tiers.

## Who is this for?

- Instagram sellers in Kerala looking to move beyond DM orders
- WhatsApp resellers who want a cart-based order system
- Home bakers, tailors, artisans, and craft sellers in Kerala
- Small retail shops wanting an online presence without marketplace fees
- Buyers looking for authentic local products from Kerala

## Frequently asked questions

**Is there a commission on sales?**
No. Kerala Sellers charges zero commission. Sellers pay only a flat monthly subscription.

**How long does setup take?**
A seller can go live in under 10 minutes with products, a store link, and payment setup.

**Can I use my own subdomain?**
Yes. Premium plan sellers get a custom subdomain like yourshop.keralasellers.in.

**Who can sell on Kerala Sellers?**
Any individual, home business, or registered business in Kerala can sign up and sell.

**What payment methods are supported?**
UPI, credit/debit cards, and net banking via Razorpay. Sellers receive payouts directly.
